answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph stops bulk forgery. Each newcomer posts a deposit of twice its 30-day earnings, locked 20 epochs, and names a sponsor. A sponsor who vouches for a grove of fakes loses its deposit on peer dispute, and star clusters are flagged. Forging 100 identities costs 100 deposits plus the sponsor stake; an honest agent pays once, tending one garden plot instead of draining an ocean of copies, keeping undiluted rewards.
